John Pickavance <john.pickavance@bthft.nhs.uk>:
HI Amin, I hope you are well. I am writing to check the details with regards to bypassing Garmin connect for syncing smartwatch data to the Avicenna database. Recall that it was one of our requirements because we’ll be collecting data from under-16s and Garmin Connect requires participants to be 16 or over to have an account. In your additional quote dated May 31st in the “Custom Data Journey” section: Avicenna supports multiple data collection channels, including wearables such as Garmin devices. By default, data collected from participants using Garmin devices is stored in the Garmin Cloud environment and later retrieved via a set of APIs provided by the Garmin platform. While Garmin ensures full compliance with GDPR, this method may only meet some institutions' security and privacy requirements. Avicenna offers seamless integration with Garmin's Standard and Companion SDKs to address these concerns. This approach allows data collected to be directly saved on Avicenna’s participant application and subsequently stored in designated databases. The entire data journey is fully compliant with GDPR, HIPAA, PIPEDA, and FDA CFR Part 11, ensuring a higher standard of data protection. I also note that in your costings estimate (ESTIMATE # 1162 DATE 2024-08-26), the following is charged at £3, 600: Custom data journey to automatically pull different data types from the Garmin wearables and transfer securely to the designated servers and databases Our understanding is that Avicenna was able to use Garmin’s standard SDK to bypass Garmin Connect and directly sync smartwatch data with the research database. Is this correct? I ask because our contact at Garmin has recently been in touch to say that Avicenna only has use of the standard APIs which allow syncing of data via Garmin Connect and does not have access to the standard SDK. Perhaps it would be helpful to sit down with Garmin but, in this first instance, I just wanted to reach out to confirm we hadn’t misunderstood anything from the specification/costings you provided. Many thanks and best wishes, JP Dr John Pickavance Principal Data Scientist | Born in Bradford | Bradford Centre for Health Data Science Bradford Teaching Hospitals NHS Foundation Trust This message is confidential.
